chapter: Handy's Louisiana Shakers and Pelican Garden
title: Touring Texas by band bus
summary: He took the band on a 22-passenger bus through Shreveport and Texas towns.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, that's true. Well, I played there a long time. I left there and went to Shreveport. Played two nights engaging in Shreveport. Left there and I went to Bournemouth. Played two nights there. Went to Euston. Played two nights there. Went to Wichita Falls. Played one night there. Jumped back to Folkwood. Played two nights there. And come back in. But that time I had 22 passengers bus then. Yeah? What, a band bus? Yeah. 22 passengers bus on my own chauffeur.

They had the band knife on the side of the bus? Yeah. What was the knife on the side of the bus? Handis, Louisiana Shakers. Handis or John Handis? No, Handis or John Handis. You keep the same men in the band in that tub? Yeah. Was there any chance? No, the same men.
